term_decisions.Port: OperationalPort: qualified reviewed register role, not blanket equivalence
term_decisions.TradeLocation: TradeLocation: retain source location and provenance
term_decisions.PortTerminal: Terminal: maritime, not infrastructure airport Terminal
term_decisions.SourcePortRecord: SourceRecord plus separately described SourcePortFeature; retain original row and artifact
term_decisions.PortIdentityAssertion: MatchAssertion: directional predicate and exact review/evidence needed
term_decisions.PortObservationArea: Keep AIS/statistical geofence distinct; no automatic conversion to physical PortArea

relation_decisions.serves_trade_location: OperationalPort -> servesTradeLocation -> TradeLocation; reverse a legacy source-to-port record direction explicitly if needed

resource_policy: Preserve confirmed real registry IDs through reviewed aliases; never mint real IDs from synthetic example.org demo identifiers
